answers.U1-S2: He was young and scared, because cattle and bulls can be dangerous and charge at people, so he was nervous about going far from home.

answers.U1-S4: Seriously and slowly, in a calm, dignified way.

answers.U1-S6: That flamingos are rare, exotic birds that usually live in warm tropical places, so seeing them there was very unusual and special.
answers.U1-S7: Because it was so beautiful, graceful and tall, with big spread wings like an angel's, that it seemed almost heavenly to him.
answers.U1-S8: Because the first time is always the most exciting; once he got older and saw flamingos often, the newness and childhood wonder wore off.
